d: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s India visit took him to Jamnagar, Gujarat, where he praised India as a “Refining Superpower.” Firstpost examines Reliance Industries’ Jamnagar refinery, the world’s largest single-site oil refinery, its capacity to process over 1.4 million barrels of crude daily and its role in handling heavy crude from countries including Venezuela, Mexico, Canada and the US. Meanwhile, Delhi is experiencing its annual winter smog, with air quality deteriorating to “poor” levels. Firstpost explores the causes of the capital’s pollution, government measures to tackle the…
